decisions.reason: The construction site dumper is close to the firm's existing construction, industrial transport and service know-how, so management can learn from market feedback and improve it rather than exit quickly.
The inclined furniture lift uses some lifting capabilities but sits further from the firm's core heavy-duty industrial applications, making learning and commercial adaptation less certain.
The inclined building material lift fits the firm's established construction and lifting knowledge base, which supports continued refinement through engineering and customer-service feedback.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift draws on both the firm's vehicle and lifting expertise, so despite serving a somewhat peripheral niche it is still related enough to justify continued development.
